correctness.rationale: The proof derives A^2=dI in characteristic two; a four-vector independence lemma; rank(B+delta I)=N/2+2 via exclusive neighbors; and explicit invariant action. For even d the exact rank sequence N,N/2+2,4,2 yields two nilpotent size-three blocks, N/2-4 size-two nilpotent blocks and one recurrent involutive size-two block, giving cumulative populations. For odd d a four-dimensional six-step factor plus N/2-2 Jordan-two blocks at eigenvalue one gives exact fixed-subspace dimensions at divisors of six. All powers and counts were independently checked in dimensions 3–7, all distances, including exhaustive binary enumerations of Q3 and Q4 and all 4^8 states of Q3 over F4. Finite checks are not the all-size proof.

value.rationale: The chord length is a natural perturbation parameter in fault-tolerant cubical network dynamics. The theorem proves a strong structural invariance (similarity over every characteristic-two field) even when inserting a chord changes bipartiteness or creates triangles. It simultaneously gives a parity-controlled transition between universal six-period reversibility and near-universal three-update relaxation, exact orbit populations, and a sharp 1-q^{-2} last-step probability. This distinguishes network geometry from temporal algebra beyond a routine small-case census.
